answer: Sponsors underwrite an entire operator, not just its first key. violet locks crystal behind the newcomer; tide counts later keys under that sponsor-verified operator. Head \(k\) adds \(k\) new unrelated sponsors, and the applicant must top up every sponsor in the full syndicate to \(k\) locked crystal until the cluster retires. Head ten adds ten sponsors and costs 145 further crystal; ten heads consume 55 sponsors and 550 crystal, versus one sponsor and one crystal for a lone debut. Sponsors and top-ups cannot be shared.
